files.content:
# Pixel Tip Calculator

A pixel-art styled tip calculator built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Works fully offline with no external dependencies.

## Features

- Enter bill amount and number of people
- Select tip percent (10%, 15%, 20%) via toggle buttons
- Shows tip per person and total per person
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Pixel-art aesthetic using system fonts and CSS

## File Structure

- `index.html` — main page structure
- `styles.css` — pixel-art styling and responsive layout
- `script.js` — calculation logic and event handling
- `README.md` — this file

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Accessibility

- All inputs have associated labels
- Tip buttons use `aria-pressed` to indicate selection
- Results are announced via `aria-live="polite"`
- Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements
- Minimum touch target size of 44px
